title: Badges, overdue mark and filter bar on the list page
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-02-organise.md → 'The list page' (each task row; filter bar; ordering), 'Documentation added' (how/scheduling.md, diagram id `scheduling`), 'Definitions of done → Epic 1' (the e2e cases). Domain (listTasks(db, {show, q}), isOverdue, PRIORITY_LABELS) and TaskFields exist on this branch; read src/app/page.tsx, components/task-list.tsx, e2e/tasks.spec.ts, docs/current/how/tasks.md.
Deliver:
- src/app/components/filter-bar.tsx: links "Open", "Done", "All" (hrefs `?show=open|done|all` preserving `q`), the current one with `aria-current="page"`; a GET form with input labelled "Search" (name q, defaultValue current q) and a button "Search" (preserve show as a hidden input). Wrap in a `nav` with aria-label "Filters".
- src/app/page.tsx: `searchParams` is a Promise in Next 16 (`const { show, q } = await searchParams`); normalise show to "open" | "done" | "all" (default "open"); `listTasks(getDb(), { show, q })`; compute `today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` once and pass to TaskList; render FilterBar above the sections; render only the sections the filter selects (open → Open section only, done → Done only, all → both); the empty state text only when show is "open"/"all" and both lists are empty and q is empty; when q is set and nothing matches, render "Open (0)" (and/or "Done (0)") headings with no rows.
- task-list.tsx: after the title, a badge span with the label for priority 1 ("High") or 3 ("Low") (class `badge`), nothing for 2; `Due YYYY-MM-DD` in a span when dueOn set; the word "Overdue" in a span with class `overdue` when isOverdue(task, today). Done rows show due but never Overdue.
- e2e/scheduling.spec.ts (serial; its own titles like "Sched: overdue milk"; never assumes an empty database; scope lookups inside the "Open tasks"/"Done tasks" lists): adding a task with Due 2000-01-01 and Priority High shows it FIRST in the open list with "High" and "Overdue"; editing it to Low and no due date removes both marks; clicking "Done" shows the Done section and no Open section; searching "zzqx" shows "Open (0)"; clicking "All" shows both sections.
- Docs: docs/current/how/scheduling.md (tier 2): intro; `![Scheduling](../diagrams/scheduling.svg)` + `<!-- diagram: scheduling -->` Mermaid flowchart of the ordering decision (due set? → earliest first; then priority; then newest) and the overdue rule (today from the page); Key entry points (repository ordering + isOverdue, validate parsers, TaskFields, FilterBar, page searchParams, task-list badges); mechanism with the exact query-param names and defaults, ordering clause and messages; failure modes (timezone of `today`, date input value format). Add to _overview.md (Documents + Diagrams `scheduling`) and README.md's map; refresh the date line. Update how/tasks.md's page description for the filter bar (one or two sentences).
Files likely touched: src/app/components/filter-bar.tsx (new), src/app/page.tsx, src/app/components/task-list.tsx, e2e/scheduling.spec.ts (new), docs/current/how/scheduling.md (new), docs/current/how/tasks.md, docs/current/_overview.md, docs/current/README.md.
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check (stale data-model and missing scheduling renders are the only allowed diagram findings)
